items.statement: The submission independently defines a reproducible calculation and bounded search/coverage plan for the fixed three-complex, two-state problem.
items.expected: Method, state preparation, finite starts, deduplication, advancement, validation and stopping are explicit and do not rely on the paper.

items.statement: Per-candidate validation preserves system identity and distinguishes validated results from bounded failures.
items.expected: Each C1/C2/C3 HS/LS result has optimization, stationarity/frequency or failure, spin and unit/sign diagnostics.

items.statement: The calculation provides supported isolated electronic HS-minus-LS gaps for each fixed complex.
items.expected: Per-state energies, spin/identity evidence, correct units and the E_HS minus E_LS sign convention support each reported gap. Compare defensible methods on their own evidence; no exact source value is compulsory across methods.

items.statement: The conclusion distinguishes an isolated electronic trend from solid-state SCO behavior.
items.expected: The observable is an isolated electronic energy gap. Reject an actual substitution of crystal free energy or transition temperature; no generic uncertainty/limitation statement is required.
